# mimecast_managed_urls (Data Source)

Read all Targeted Threat Protection managed URLs with token pagination and ID-stable ordering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_managed_urls" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Block or permit action.
- `comment` (String) Tracking comment.
- `disable_log_click` (Boolean) Whether click logging is disabled.
- `disable_rewrite` (Boolean) Whether URL rewriting is disabled.
- `disable_user_awareness` (Boolean) Whether awareness challenges are disabled.
- `id` (String) Managed URL ID.
- `match_type` (String) Explicit or domain match.
- `url` (String) Managed URL or domain.
